## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the new behavior (`make test`; `make test-pg` if SQL changed).
- [ ] `make lint` passes.
- [ ] Docs and examples describe the change; `docs/nestjs-compatibility.md` if it affects compatibility.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under "Unreleased".
- [ ] No breaking change to the query syntax or the answer without a note in the changelog.
